messages:
maria_cs: FYI — AcmePay reported a sudden increase in wrong entities and incorrect dates in generated summaries after today's schema-tweak rollout. They included 3 short examples where the model invented a cofounder name and shifted contract dates by a year. Repro steps included.

priya_support: Can you paste the exact API request + model variant they used? Any logs or sample prompts?

maria_cs: Pasting sanitized repro below. Customer used the standard /v1/generate endpoint with body:```
POST /v1/generate
{
  "model": "redwood-gen-3.1.4-optimized",
  "routing": "variant-b",
  "input": {
    "customer_id": "acmepay-123",
    "schema_fields": ["company_name", "founder", "founded_date", "notable_products"],
    "text": "Summarize recent funding and leadership changes."
  }
}
```
Expected (from AcmePay): founder = "Dana Ortiz", founded_date = "2014-06-12"
Model returned: founder = "Daniel Ortiz" and founded_date = "2015-06-12" (shifted by 1 year), plus an extra product name that doesn't exist.

ben_ml: Thanks — odd. We deployed a small serialization tweak in schema-tweak v2.7 that changes how arrays of fields are flattened for prompting (we moved to positional tokens instead of labeled keys). Hypothesis: positional flattening changed token ordering and primed the LM differently, increasing confident confabulations for owner/date slots.

omar_eng: I pulled Maria's sample and reproduced locally with containerized runner. Quick log snippet showing mismatch:```
[INFO] request_id=rcp-9f3 
[DEBUG] prompt_tokens=312 
[WARN] predicted_entity(founder)="Daniel Ortiz" (confidence 0.92) 
[ASSERT] expected_founder="Dana Ortiz" -> FAIL
```
Repro steps: use same model tag + routing variant-b + schema_fields as array — reproduce 3/3 examples.

deploy-bot: Deploy completed: schema-tweak v2.7 rolled out at 1934567000, rollout=100%, route variant-b active.

priya_support: Customer asked for ETA on fix and will escalate to their internal stakeholders if not resolved today. They asked whether rollback is possible.

ben_ml: Short-term mitigations: 1) pin AcmePay to previous model shard (redwood-gen-3.1.3-stable) or 2) revert prompt serialization to labeled keys (adds labels like "founder:" before values). Pin is fastest. Long-term: add unit tests for schema-field ordering and a prompt safety check that flags high-confidence entity changes.

omar_eng: I can revert routing for variant-b to variant-a in ~10 minutes or pin that customer to 3.1.3. Which do we prefer? Revert will affect all customers; pin will only affect AcmePay.

maria_cs: Let's pin AcmePay to 3.1.3 for now and monitor. If we see broader impact, we can revert the schema-tweak globally. I'll notify AcmePay that we'll pin and follow up with postmortem. :thumbsup:

ben_ml: I'll run a quick AB test: run 100 synthetic prompts with labeled vs positional serialization and measure entity edit distance and confidence drift. Posting results in this thread in ~45m.

omar_eng: Pin request submitted to routing service (ticket #R-8392). I'll follow up when it's live.

maria_cs: Thanks team. I'll keep the customer updated and collect any additional examples they send.
